messages:
maria: Quick heads up — aiming to ship canary for release 2025.03.1 at 18:00 UTC. I don't have prod press rights anymore after the role refactor. Who can run the push? We also need to pin runtime to v1.4.2 for this canary (kernel mismatch otherwise).

devon: I can do it but my MFA app needs re-enroll, won't be back online for ~25m. Is there an option to delegate to a svcacct?

tess: I can cover if devon can't. Two caveats: 1) I'm on-call for infra till 18:30 so limited, 2) need the deploy gate to allow manual override for canary routing.

raj: I have the key but I am in APAC — will be awake. If we do a staged canary (10% -> 50%) I can press the final if the first stage is green.

maria: Plan: start 18:00 small canary (10%), smoke 5 mins, then 50% if no regressions. We must pin the runtime SHA before any of that: `pin runtime: release/runtime@v1.4.2` in the deployment config.

maria: @sre-bot can you show current pin and any pending kernel mismatches?

sre-bot: deploy-check: runtime pin detected: v1.4.1 -> recommended v1.4.2. Known mismatches on 4/6 GPU hosts (nvcr-skuX) at seq_len 2048. See: https://internal.ops/runtime-mismatch/2025-03

devon: ok I can re-enroll MFA quickly, ETA 12m. If someone wants to claim immediate press, shout now.

tess: I can claim now and hold for devon to confirm. If devon ready before 18:10 we can handover. :thumbsup:

raj: +1 to that handoff. Also confirm release notes + rollback tag exists. If we need to rollback, we should revert to runtime v1.4.0 (known-good).

maria: Release notes link: https://docs/release/2025-03-1 (added changelog + eval summary). Rollback plan added in notes: `rollback -> runtime@v1.4.0 + traffic-zeroing`

tess: Command I'd run once granted: ```
./ship.sh --env=prod --canary --runtime=release/runtime@v1.4.2 --pin
```

maria: Ok assigning press to tess for initial canary. Tess — when you press, paste deploy-bot output here and call for a 5m smoke. If any errors, escalate to raj and we'll run rollback plan.

tess: Claimed and ready, starting MFA now. Will post logs.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: authorization check passed for tess. Triggering canary. commit 7a1f3e -> canary started at 2025-03-11T18:00:12Z (10% traffic).

maria: Thanks all. If devon gets MFA before 18:10 we'll do handoff, otherwise raj will be standby to finalize.

devon: MFA done, I'm good to take over after smoke. Will stand by.

(timetick) 18:06 — tess: initial smoke looks clean, no errors in 5m. Proceed to 50%?

raj: I'll hit finalize when you call it.

tess: Going to 50% now. deploy-bot: canary -> 50% at 2025-03-11T18:07:01Z.

sre-bot: monitoring: no increase in 5xx, latency stable.

maria: rolling forward. Great teamwork.
